title: Preventive Dentistry
html:
The American Dental Association (ADA) recommends dental visits at least twice per year. Regular exams and professional cleanings can help to ensure optimal oral health. At Mason Park Dental, our team consistently provides high-quality dental cleanings and thorough preventive exams. Professional cleanings rid the teeth of harmful plaque and tartar build-up. This is important for preventing tooth decay, periodontal disease, and other oral health issues for your child. Additionally, a professional cleaning by our hygienist may remove some surface stains. This can help keep your child’s teeth looking whiter and brighter. During your child's examination, we will also:
  • Evaluate their overall oral health
  • Discuss oral hygiene practices and habits
  • Check their bite and jaw for any issues
  • Evaluate their risk of tooth decay, gum disease, and oral cancer
  • Evaluate existing tooth restorations
  • Take dental x-rays if necessary
Regular professional dental cleanings and exams are essential for maintaining a healthy mouth and a beautiful smile. Contact Katy pediatric dentist to request an appointment for a dental exam and cleaning.
